0.original: Eshana has a task for a helpful adventurer.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Throw the acrid-smelling powder on signal fires.

48.original: Are you feeling helpful, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? The hour has come to call in the patrols, but I cannot leave my ssstation.

49.original: I would be grateful if you could head out and throw thisss powder onto our sssignal fires─the sssmoke will let our ssscouts know that fresh patrols are on the way to relieve them.

50.original: Here. I'll mark the places on your map where the fires are to be found. A trifling tasssk, I know, but I appreciate your aid nonetheless.

51.original: You hear the voice of an alerted scout from the direction of the Velodyna River.

53.original: (-Distant Scout-)I hope the next ssscout has more luck tracking that big antlion than I did...

54.original: (-Nearby Scout-)Already? My report will be a dull one, but I sssuppose those are the mossst welcome.

55.original: (-Nearby Scout-)Time to head back. I needed to sharpen my blade again in any case.

56.original: You hear the beating wings of a griffin approaching from the direction of Virdjala...

58.original: You hear the steady clomp of booted feet approaching from the direction of Virdjala...

59.original: <cough> Oof, that stuff doesn't half make your eyes water. Thanks for the signal!

60.original: Thank you. Our patrols range far and wide out here on the border, and lines of communication can be difficult to maintain.

61.original: Griffins fly ssswiftly, of courssse, but a sssignal fire does the job even fassster. Even if the sssmoke does reek like a pile of marid...ahem, well it cannot be helped.

62.original: If you don't mind ssstretching your legs, I could probably use your help the next time we call in the ssscouts.
